en.name: Coconut water
en.summary: An unopened carton or can of coconut water keeps 12 months from purchase in a cool cupboard, but only 1–2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened. That collapse is not a misprint: coconut water is sweet and barely acidic, so once air gets in it is close to an ideal growth medium.
en.pantry: 12 months from purchase, unopened, somewhere cool, dark and dry. Shelf-stable coconut water gets that year from heat treatment and a sealed, oxygen-proof pack, not from anything in the liquid itself — which is why the pantry figure applies only while the seal is intact. Store the cartons away from the sun and the hob, and reject any pack that is swollen, leaking or hissing when you open it. Fresh coconut water straight from a young nut is a different product entirely and belongs in the fridge immediately.
en.fridge: 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened, capped and kept on a shelf rather than in the door. Coconut water is mostly water and sugar with almost no acid and no preservative, so an opened carton left even overnight on the counter can turn. It also picks up fridge smells quickly, so keep the cap on. Pour into a glass rather than drinking from the carton if you plan to keep the rest, because backwash shortens even this short window.
en.freezer: Freezing coconut water is common practice — into ice cubes for smoothies, for example — and does no harm beyond a slight separation, which stirs back in. Leave headspace for expansion, and thaw in the fridge rather than on the counter.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and shake well. Once thawed, treat it as opened coconut water and drink it within the refrigerated window.
spoilage: A sour, yeasty or fermented smell instead of a clean sweetness.
A pink or grey tinge, or visible cloudiness and sediment that was not there before.
A swollen carton or can, which should go unopened.
tips: Buy the size you will finish in a sitting; an opened carton is a two-day item at best.
Cap it and keep it on a fridge shelf, not in the door.
Freeze leftovers as ice cubes rather than trying to stretch the opened window.
Some pink discolouration in natural coconut water comes from the coconut itself, but combined with a sour smell it means the carton goes.

faq.q: How long does coconut water last once opened?
faq.a: 1–2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, capped.

faq.q: Does unopened coconut water need refrigerating?
faq.a: No. A shelf-stable pack keeps 12 months from purchase in a cool cupboard while the seal is intact. Everything changes the moment you open it.

faq.q: How can you tell if coconut water has gone bad?
faq.a: Smell it. Sour, yeasty or fermented notes, fizzing on pouring, or a swollen pack all mean it goes.

zh.name: 椰子水
zh.summary: 未開封的椰子水利樂包或罐裝，自購買日起放陰涼櫥櫃可放 12 個月；但開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏只有 1～2 天。這個斷崖不是印錯：椰子水甜、又幾乎沒有酸度，空氣一進去，它就近乎是理想的培養基。
zh.pantry: 未開封，放在陰涼、避光、乾燥處，自購買日起 12 個月。常溫椰子水的這一年，來自熱處理與完全隔絕氧氣的包裝，不是來自液體本身——所以櫥櫃的數字只在封口完整時成立。請把包裝收在遠離陽光與爐台的地方；鼓脹、滲漏，或打開時會噴氣的就別喝。直接從椰青裡倒出來的新鮮椰子水是完全不同的東西，必須立刻冷藏。
zh.fridge: 開封後蓋好、放 4 °C 以下冷藏 1～2 天，放層架而不是冰箱門。椰子水幾乎就是水加糖，沒什麼酸、也沒有防腐劑，所以開封後的一盒就算只在檯面上過一夜也可能壞掉。它也很會吸冰箱的味道，請把蓋子蓋緊。如果要留下半盒，請倒進杯子喝，不要對著口喝，口水回流連這個短窗口都會再縮短。
zh.freezer: 冷凍椰子水是常見做法——例如凍成冰塊打果昔——除了會稍微分層之外沒什麼問題，攪一攪就回來了。請留膨脹空間，並用冷藏解凍，不要放在檯面上退冰。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍並搖勻。解凍後就當成已開封的椰子水，在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 聞起來酸、有酵母味或發酵味，而不是乾淨的清甜。
出現原本沒有的粉紅或灰色調，或明顯混濁與沉澱。
包裝鼓脹——那種連開都不要開。
tips: 買一次喝得完的容量；開封後頂多就是兩天的東西。
蓋緊後放冰箱層架，不要放門邊。
喝不完就凍成冰塊，不要硬撐開封後的期限。
天然椰子水本身可能會有些微粉紅，但只要同時有酸味，整盒就該倒掉。

faq.q: 椰子水開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 1～2 天。

faq.q: 未開封的椰子水需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不用。常溫包裝在封口完整時，自購買日起放陰涼櫥櫃可放 12 個月。一開封就完全是另一回事了。
用聞的。酸味、酵母味、發酵味，倒出來起泡，或包裝鼓脹，都代表該倒掉。
